name: Landing
description: Tests of how a lander descends, detects hazards and touches down: navigation, guidance and how the surface reacts under the vehicle.

name: Rover
description: Driving robotic or crewed rovers on terrain that behaves like the Moon or Mars: mobility, navigation, sampling and remote operations.

name: Base
description: Living and working in a habitat as a crew would at a permanent base: isolation, life support, logistics and use of local resources.
